settings.title: Settings
settings.themeDesc: Light, dark, or match your system
settings.uiStyleDesc: Spotify, Apple Music or Nothing look
settings.nothingDotsDesc: Dot-matrix seek and volume bars; off shows plain lines
settings.blurBgDesc: Fill the background with a blurred version of the current song's art
settings.dynamicAccentColorDesc: Tint the app's accent color to match the current song's cover art
settings.crossfadeDesc: Blend the end of one song into the start of the next
settings.replayGainDesc: Even out loudness differences between tracks (needs ReplayGain data on the server)
settings.equalizerDesc: Shape the sound with a 5-band graphic equalizer (desktop and Android)
settings.loudnessBoostDesc: Native volume boost, on top of the normal volume slider (Android only)
settings.discordPresenceDesc: Shows what you're listening to on your Discord profile (desktop only)
settings.catJamDesc: Show a cat that bounces to the beat next to the player
settings.customCssDesc: Write your own CSS to further tweak the app's look. Applied live.
settings.offlineModeDesc: Only show and play songs you've downloaded — everything else is grayed out
settings.albumArtLookupDesc: Sends the artist/album name to Deezer's public search API when your Jellyfin server doesn't have cover art. Turn off to keep that from ever leaving your device.
settings.autoUpdateCheckDesc: Checks GitHub in the background for a newer Triptych release. No personal data is sent, just a version lookup. Turn off to check manually via the Releases page instead.
settings.catJamCredit: "Cat Jam" animation adapted from BlafKing's spicetify-cat-jam-synced
settings.clearDownloadsConfirm: Remove all {count} downloaded songs from this device? They stay in your library and can be downloaded again.
settings.hapticsDesc: Short vibrations on swipes, long-press menus and pull-to-refresh
settings.lyricsSearchDesc: Lets you find songs by a line of their lyrics. Fetches your library's lyrics in the background (song titles and artists go to lrclib.net and lyrics.ovh) and keeps them on this device.

privacyNotice.text: Triptych keeps everything on your own device and your own Jellyfin server. A couple of background lookups (album art, update checks) talk to outside services — see the Privacy Policy for exactly what's sent, and turn them off any time in Settings.

whatsNew.title: What's new in {version}
whatsNew.subtitle: Here's what's new.
whatsNew.appleStyleDesc: Settings → Appearance → Interface style now lets you switch between the Spotify look and a new Apple Music look.
whatsNew.instantSkipDesc: The next song buffers in the background, so Next (and going back) starts right away.
whatsNew.sheetsDesc: On phones, the queue and full-size lyrics slide up from the bottom of the player.
whatsNew.gesturesDesc: Swipe the cover to change songs, swipe down to close the player, and pull down any page to refresh it.
whatsNew.phoneVolumeDesc: On Android, the volume slider controls your phone's volume and follows the volume buttons.
whatsNew.updatesDesc: On PC, new versions now download and install right from the app.
whatsNew.shortcutsDesc: Space plays and pauses, Ctrl + ← and Ctrl + → skip to the previous or next song.
whatsNew.polishDesc: New animations, a loading screen instead of the login flash, more reliable lyrics, faster loading and lots of fixes.
whatsNew.resumeTitle: Pick up where you left off
whatsNew.resumeDesc: Triptych remembers your queue, song and position, and has them ready the next time you open it.
whatsNew.smartHomeDesc: New rows: Jump Back In, Because you listened to…, and Newly Added.
whatsNew.wrappedDesc: On December 31 your year in music arrives as a story: minutes, top artist (drumroll, please), top songs and more.
whatsNew.listenTimeDesc: Stats now count the time you actually listen, across all your devices, instead of estimating from plays.
whatsNew.storageDesc: See how much space downloads use and remove them, and turn vibration feedback on or off.
whatsNew.queueOrderTitle: A queue that keeps your order
whatsNew.queueOrderDesc: Songs you add play in the order you added them, before the rest of the album. The queue shows them separately under "Next in queue".
whatsNew.adaptiveQualityDesc: Automatic streaming quality now measures your connection and lowers the bitrate on slow or mobile connections.
whatsNew.fasterLoadingDesc: Cover images are sized for your screen, and the next song only preloads once the current one is downloaded.
whatsNew.nothingStyleDesc: A third interface style next to Spotify and Apple Music, inspired by Nothing OS: black and white, dot-matrix headings and lyrics, thin outline icons and a red accent you can change. Pick it in Settings → Appearance.
whatsNew.smallScreensDesc: On short screens the full-screen player keeps the big cover and tightens everything else, so the controls, volume and lyrics all stay visible. Settings fits narrow screens too.
whatsNew.iosPlaybackDesc: Music keeps playing in the background, the lock screen and Control Center controls always work, and the volume slider follows the volume buttons.
whatsNew.nothingSlidersDesc: In the Nothing style you can now switch the dotted seek and volume bars to plain lines: Settings → Appearance → Dotted sliders.
whatsNew.lyricsSearchDesc: Remember a line but not the title? Turn on "Search by lyrics" in Settings → Privacy, then type the line in Search.
whatsNew.listeningCalendarDesc: Stats now shows a dot for every day you listened, brighter the more you played, plus your longest streak.
whatsNew.listTotalsDesc: Albums, playlists, Liked Songs and Downloads show their total length, like "19 songs · 1 hr 14 min".
whatsNew.realPlaysDesc: A song counts as played once you have heard at least half of it. Skips no longer add plays, and your listening time no longer resets after an update.
whatsNew.renameDesc: Same app, new name and logo. Your login, settings, downloads and listening stats all carry over.
whatsNew.languagesDesc: All 15 languages now cover every screen, setting and message, including Wrapped, Import and the legal pages' menu.
whatsNew.calendarMonthsDesc: The listening calendar shows each month as its own block and fits on any phone without scrolling sideways.
whatsNew.ownIdentityDesc: Triptych now has its own app id, so nothing is called JellyWave anymore. Your settings and listening stats come from your server; on phones, downloaded songs need to be downloaded again.
whatsNew.installerDesc: Triptych artwork, a welcome page in your language, and the license agreement to accept.

wrapped.bannerSub: Your top songs, artists and minutes, as a story
wrapped.estimatedNote: Estimated from your plays. Exact listening time is counted from now on, so next time this gets more precise.
